lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Whenever Akshan uses a basic attack, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals 50% AD physical damage, increased to 100% AD against minions. Issuing an on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes Akshan to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains 35–75|ms (+ 100% bonus attack speed) bonus movement speed decaying over 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The additional shot applies on-hit and on-attack effects at 100% effectiveness and benefits from critical strike modifiers at 30% effectiveness.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Akshan's basic attacks and abilities apply a stack to affected enemies for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing on subsequent applications. The third stack consumes them all to deal 20–175 bonus magic damage and, if the target is a champion, Akshan is granted a 40–300 (+ 40% bonus AD) shield for 2 seconds. The shield may only be gained once every few seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Static Cooldown: 16–4 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Akshan hurls a boomerang in the target direction, dealing 5–85 (+ 80% AD) physical damage to enemies hit and standard sight them for 1 second, granting sight of the area along its path, as well as extending its range every time it hits an enemy. If the boomerang hits an enemy champion, Akshan gains 40% bonus movement speed decaying over 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Upon reaching maximum range, the boomerang returns to Akshan. Enemies can be hit once per pass.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Avengerang deals 40–70% damage against non-champions.

lines.note: Passive: Enemy champions that kill allied champions are marked as a Scoundrel for 60 seconds. Upon scoring a takedown against a Scoundrel within 3 seconds of damaging them, Akshan receives an additional and revives all death allied champions that were slain by that enemy champion after 1 second at their summoning platform, and removes the marks from all other enemies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Akshan enters camouflage, which lasts for 2 seconds or indefinitely while he is near terrain or inside brush. Going Rogue can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.

lines.note: Attacking or casting abilities ends Going Rogue immediately.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: While Going Rogue and moving towards nearby Scoundrels, Akshan gains 80–120 bonus movement speed and bonus mana regeneration equal to 12% of his missing mana. He can also see trails leading towards Scoundrels.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Akshan can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. Akshan may input a movement command to use the second and third casts.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: First Cast: Akshan fires a hook in the target direction, which grapples to the first instance of terrain hit for 1.5 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If Akshan becomes immobilize or ground during this time, the hook will detach, ending Heroic Swing prematurely.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Second Cast: Akshan dash around the terrain, rapidly firing at the nearest sight enemy to deal them 30–130 (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 30% bonus attack speed) physical damage per shot and apply on-hit and on-attack effects at 25% effectiveness per shot. He stops the swing upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain, or after 3 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Akshan will be knockdown by any immobilize crowd control during the dash.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Third Cast: Akshan dash off of the rope to the target location and fires one last shot at a nearby sight enemy.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Heroic Swing's cooldown resets upon scoring a takedown against an enemy champion. The shots benefit from critical strike modifiers at 90% effectiveness and applies life steal life steal at 100% effectiveness. Akshan prioritizes firing at enemy champions with stacks of Dirty Fighting}}, will not fire if he is channeling Comeuppance}}, and sight himself during Heroic Swing.
